Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) provides free food grains to India's poorest households. It serves Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries across the country.

Services offered

  • Free food grains (wheat and rice)
  • 35 kg per AAY household per month
  • 5 kg per person per month for Priority Households

Source and review

Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India · Official network page published by the operator

The official page states that the government provides free food grains to AAY and PHH beneficiaries under PMGKAY for five years starting January 2024.
